title: Total Risk breakdown tooltip (totalRiskHelp) has no direct test coverage -- non-blocking review follow-up
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #166 (backend-trade-history-table-followups), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so it isn't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: frontend/src/features/portfolio/components/totalRiskHelp.ts computes the new open-vs-realized risk breakdown (`openPositionRiskPct = totalOpenRiskPct - realizedLossesThisMonthPct`) and formats it into the MetricHelp popover's `valueInterpretation` string, wired into both RiskPanel.tsx and RiskSummaryCard.tsx via the shared `common/MetricHelp` question-mark affordance. Neither RiskPanel.test.tsx nor RiskSummaryCard.test.tsx (only updated in PR #166 for the StatCard label-text rename) ever click the new 'Total Risk (Open + Realized) help' icon or assert on the resulting breakdown text/numbers -- unlike the established precedent for this exact MetricHelp usage pattern, frontend/src/features/stocks/components/IndicatorsPanel.test.tsx, which does click its help icons and assert the exact popover text/values shown. There is also no dedicated totalRiskHelp.test.ts unit-testing the arithmetic directly, unlike the sibling frontend/src/features/portfolio/components/metricHelpContent.ts's own metricHelpContent.test.ts (which hand-checks each help object's interpretValue against worked examples). Coverage tooling reports totalRiskHelp.ts at 100% only because the function is called unconditionally during component render (regardless of whether the popover is ever opened) -- no test currently asserts its output is correct. A future change that flips the subtraction order, swaps which field is passed as totalOpenRiskPct vs realizedLossesThisMonthPct, or otherwise breaks the arithmetic would pass CI silently. Manually verified via a real browser walkthrough during PR #166's review that the current arithmetic and rendered text are correct (1.93% open + 691.79% realized = 693.72% total, matching the live /api/portfolio/risk response) -- this finding is about locking that in with an automated test, not about a live bug. Surfaced independently by both the code-review skill and pr-reviewer's own manual check during PR #166's review.

decisions.decision: Added frontend/src/features/portfolio/components/totalRiskHelp.test.ts, a dedicated unit test suite hand-checking totalRiskHelp's own arithmetic (matching the sibling metricHelpContent.test.ts's pattern of hand-checked interpretValue-style output) against the exact PR #166-review-verified live values (693.72% total = 1.93% open + 691.79% realized), plus edge cases where the total is entirely open-position risk or entirely realized losses, plus a check that the fixed label/definition/elderContext text carries through unchanged. Also added a click-through test to both RiskPanel.test.tsx and RiskSummaryCard.test.tsx that clicks the 'Total Risk (Open + Realized) help' button and asserts the exact rendered breakdown text, matching IndicatorsPanel.test.tsx's established click-and-assert precedent for this exact MetricHelp usage pattern. Implemented as part of a batched PR (#208) alongside four other unrelated small follow-up tasks, per explicit user instruction to batch remaining small followups onto one branch/PR.
decisions.rationale: Both the direct unit test (totalRiskHelp.test.ts) and the component-level click-through tests (RiskPanel.test.tsx/RiskSummaryCard.test.tsx) were added rather than just one of the two, since the finding explicitly named both gaps as missing precedent (metricHelpContent.test.ts's direct-unit-test pattern, and IndicatorsPanel.test.tsx's click-and-assert pattern) -- a single test type would have closed only half the gap the review identified. This task's id/area/references were originally authored for a frontend/pages/portfolio finding despite the 'backend-trade-history-table' id prefix (a naming quirk noted in this batch's dispatch instructions, not a bug to fix here) -- no change made to those fields.
